title: When Magnitude Suffices: Reconstructing Time-Domain-Gated Microwave Signals Without Phase on a Thoracic Phantom
abstract: arXiv:2610.23608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-domain gating separates the arrivals that form a microwave S-parameter measurement. It requires the measurement of complex values, so this application almost always uses a vector network analyzer (VNA). We show that, on one calibrated measurement configuration, the gated magnitude the VNA would give can be reconstructed from a magnitude-only sweep of a spectrum analyzer with a tracking generator (SA). We select the gate center for separability of the measured states, correct each instrument once by a per-bin subtraction of a reference state, and train a fully connected network on sweeps from both instruments. The test object is a torso phantom with lung-shaped compartments whose filling takes eleven dielectric states, each held out in turn. On $S_{11}$ the reconstruction from SA input reaches a shape error of 0.08 dB$^2$ with a state ordering of 0.81. This matches the reconstruction from VNA input. On $S_{21}$ it reaches 0.82 dB$^2$

translated_title: 当幅度足够时：在胸部体模上无相位重构时域门控微波信号
translated_abstract: 时域门控技术用于分离构成微波S参数测量的各到达信号。它需要复数值测量，因此该应用几乎总是使用矢量网络分析仪（VNA）。我们证明，在一种校准的测量配置下，矢量网络分析仪所能给出的门控幅度可以从配备跟踪信号源的频谱分析仪（SA）的仅幅度扫描中重构出来。我们选择门中心以实现测量状态的可分离性，通过对参考状态的逐频点减法对每台仪器进行一次性校正，并在两台仪器的扫描数据上训练一个全连接网络。测试对象是一个具有肺形容腔的躯干体模，其填充物具有十一种介电状态，每种状态依次被留出作为测试。在$S_{11}$上，从SA输入的重构达到0.08 dB$^2$的形状误差和0.81的状态排序，与从VNA输入的重构结果相当。在$S_{21}$上，其误差为0.82 dB$^2$。
tldr: 该研究证明，仅使用频谱分析仪的幅度测量数据结合全连接神经网络，即可在胸部体模上重构出与矢量网络分析仪结果相当的时域门控微波信号幅度，无需昂贵的相位信息测量。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that magnitude-only spectrum analyzer measurements combined with a fully connected neural network can reconstruct time-domain-gated microwave signal magnitudes on a thoracic phantom, matching vector network analyzer performance without requiring phase information.
